src='''def transform(grid):
    height = len(grid)
    width = len(grid[0])
    marked = set()

    for i, row in enumerate(grid):
        if all(value == row[0] for value in row):
            marked.update((i, j) for j in range(width))

    for j in range(width):
        value = grid[0][j]
        if all(grid[i][j] == value for i in range(height)):
            marked.update((i, j) for i in range(height))

    output = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for i, j in marked:
        output[i][j] = 2
    return output
'''
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); p.write_text(src)
